answer_1.quote: Specifically, KBQG generates natural language questions according to a set of facts extracted from KB

answer_2.quote: We adopt BLEU-n (n = 1-4) and ROUGE-L as automatic evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: We also hire three people to evaluate the relevance and fluency of the generated questions.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored fluency and relevance on a five-point Likert scale (1: poor, 5: perfect).
